brief.headline: Push for a 10–15% price cut to the ₹0.65–0.80/pc band shown in the open market, backed by three large alternate converters ready to quote.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut that brings the typical 28 mm induction-wad PP cap down to ₹0.65–0.80/pc.
priceAsk.basis: Open-market asking prices for this cap sit at ₹0.55–1.20/pc, with typical deals at ₹0.85–0.95/pc. The market verdict is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec. We want that headroom.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 days after receipt — no concession without a matching price cut.

brief.financialLeverage: Rachana publishes no financials, so we cannot see their revenue, profit or cash position. That means our leverage comes from our spend and our backups. We spend ₹44.37 L a year with them — a solid account. We have three strong alternate converters already on file: Manjushree Technopack (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, India's largest rigid-plastic converter), Mold-Tek Packaging (a listed, profitable rigid-plastic leader), and Hitech Corporation (listed, broad moulded-packaging capability). Without their financial picture, we lean on competitive tension and the threat of a second source to push price.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms — with ₹2569.83 Cr revenue and a B health score (65/100). Top second-source candidate.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader covering pails, containers, and pharma packaging; strong and profitable — a robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed converter with broad moulded and blow-moulded packaging capability across bottles and caps.

risks: Rachana does not publish financials, so we cannot gauge how much pressure they can absorb — watch for any sign they are struggling or over-stretched.
Our current price is already at the MARKET-FAIR level — pushing too hard without qualifying a second source first could leave us scrambling if they walk.
If we switch to an alternate, expect a lead time to validate their tooling and run trials — do not cut Rachana loose until the backup is qualified.
The open-market ask is for a 28 mm cap — confirm our spec matches before using that ₹0.65–0.80/pc target in the room.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We see the market for a 28 mm PP cap sitting at ₹0.85–0.95, with room down to ₹0.65–0.80 at volume — and we've lined up three large converters ready to quote, so let's talk about how we get there together.
